body:
Follow-up from SC-028 (v2.4, spec .adlc/specs/SC-027-v24-ux-hierarchy-profile.md F8). README.md was a frozen rail for SC-028, so its judge path still describes v2.3 visibility: step 1 says each pantry item shows its reason (for example 'Bought on 17 days...'), and step 6 says the page lists every tool the agent called with its arguments. In v2.4 the pantry reason sits behind each row's short timing label (for example 'Due in 2 days'), and the tool list sits behind 'How this was calculated: N agent tool calls'. The README also does not mention the Karuppan profile card, the recommendation line on the Plan step, or that HNB offers are labelled fictional.

Change only README.md wording; no code change.

Acceptance criteria:
1. README step 1 tells the judge to open a row's timing label to see the purchase-history reason, and step 6 tells the judge to open 'How this was calculated' to see the tool calls. Verify: rg -n "How this was calculated" README.md
2. The README checker passes. Verify: python scripts/check_judge_readme.py
3. Every test still passes. Verify: python -m pytest -q
title: Update the README judge path for v2.4's collapsed tool list and pantry reasons
